config.name: apiKey
config.description: Your Apify API token for authenticated access. Get it from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required for data retrieval; optional for server discovery and capability listing.

tools.name: search_local_businesses
tools.description: Search Google Maps for local businesses matching a query and location. Returns business name, complete address, star rating, review count, phone number, website URL, and business category. Use for restaurant discovery, service provider lookup, or competitive local analysis. Returns open/closed status.

params.name: query
params.description: Business type or name to find (e.g. 'plumbers near me', 'Thai restaurants', 'Starbucks')

params.name: location
params.description: Geographic location as city, zip code, or address (e.g. 'Los Angeles, CA', '90210', '1600 Pennsylvania Ave')

params.name: max_results
params.description: Number of business results to return (default 10, max 50 for large searches)

tools.name: generate_leads
tools.description: Extract B2B lead lists from Google Maps by business category and geography. Returns company name, full address, contact phone, website, business category, and review metrics. Use for sales prospecting, market research, or building vendor lists. Returns 20+ leads per query by default.

params.name: city
params.description: City where businesses are located (e.g. 'Denver', 'New York', 'San Francisco')

params.name: max_results
params.description: Number of leads to generate (default 20, recommended for data quality)

params.name: business_type
params.description: Industry or business category to target (e.g. 'HVAC contractors', 'dental clinics', 'software development firms')

tools.name: validate_emails
tools.description: Validate and verify email addresses for deliverability, format compliance, and mailbox existence. Returns pass/fail status per email, syntax errors, domain validity, and SMTP verification result. Use before sending bulk emails to prevent bounces and protect sender reputation.

params.name: emails
params.description: Array of email addresses to validate for syntax, domain, and deliverability

prompts.name: lead_generation
prompts.description: Generate a qualified lead list for a business category in a specific area with contact details and ratings.

prompts.name: local_search
prompts.description: Find and compare local businesses matching specific criteria with ratings and reviews.

resources.name: Server Capabilities
resources.description: Available capabilities: local business search, B2B lead generation, and email validation.
